d:
Watch Jingiliya from Puli in Devi Sri Prasad's music. Javed Ali & Pooja AV's voice adds zing to this folk song with peppy beats and tongue-twisting lyrics by Vairamuthu.
Song Name - Jingiliya
Movie - Puli
Singer - Javed Ali & Pooja AV
Music - Devi Sri Prasad
Lyrics - Vairamuthu
Director - Chimbu Deven
Starring - Ilayathalapathy Vijay, Sridevi, Sudeep, Shruti Haasan, Hansika Motwani
